# 11 — MVE pipeline brief · RETIRED as a source, 26 August 2026

**Do not edit this file. It is no longer the brief.**

On 26 August the brief was rebuilt on the canonical KOR design system
(`tools/BdDocTemplate/`) and merged with the meeting material from
`09-MVE-DEMO-DOSSIER.md`, so that **Jim carries one document instead of three that
contradicted each other**. This markdown is kept only so the filename still resolves.

## Where the brief lives now

| | |
|---|---|
| **Shipped artifact** | `docs/KOR-MVE-Pipeline-Brief-2026-08-26-web.pdf` (11 pp) |
| **Source** | `docs/audit-2026-08/mve-pipeline-brief.html` — assembled; see the build comment at the top of that file |
| **Edit here** | `mve-pipeline-body.html` (content) and `mve-pipeline-print.html` (print density only) |
| **Research detail** | `mve-pipeline/P4-session2-resolutions.md`, and `P1`–`P3` |

## Why it changed

1. **It is now the single meeting document.** It absorbed *who is in the room* and the
   *do-not-raise* list from the demo dossier, and merged the two competing
   "questions to ask" lists into one. The demo dossier and the company profile are
   background reading.
2. **The previous build was off-standard and defective.** It came from a `build_doc.py`
   that lived only in a session scratchpad, in no repo, whose running footer
   (`position:fixed; bottom:5mm`) sat *inside* the text column and overprinted body text
   on most pages of every document it produced — including
   `KOR-MVE-Pipeline-Brief-2026-08-25-web.pdf`, which struck through a line about Hines'
   Riverwalk townhomes. `BdDocTemplate` has no fixed footer and does not have this fault.

⚠ **The other `audit-2026-08` documents are still on the old builder** —
`_exec-summary.html`, `_mve-dossier.html` and `_mve-company.html`, and the PDFs made from
them. They carry the same overprinting defect and have not been re-rendered.
